main_body: marble column with capital, shaft, and base
top_band: light grey/white horizontal surface of the column capital across rows 9-12, bounded by a bright white front-edge highlight at row 12
evidence: Reading down the center column: row 8 is the top outline, rows 9-11 form a light grey top plane, row 12 is a bright white front-edge highlight line (4 rows total for the top surface), rows 13-15 are the shaded front face and underside of the capital overhang, row 16 is an eave shadow on the top of the shaft, rows 17-40 are the cylindrical shaft shaded from left to right, and rows 41-47 form a matching 3/4 base with its own top shelf (rows 41-44) and front face (rows 45-46).

style.evidence: The marble column uses a 6-step cool grey/white ramp with smooth cylindrical form shading, specular highlights on the horizontal shelves, and dark cool-grey outlines rather than pure black. Although a smooth marble column naturally has less surface clutter than a market stall, the pixel cluster work and form rendering are clean and cohesive.
